description: Headless CMS on top of laravel/base + laravel/filament: Page (soft deleted, with noindex, own social image and updated_at) and SiteSetting models and Filament resources, a block catalogue as the one source of the block types (the Filament Builder is generated from it and a validator refuses unknown blocks and fields), page revisions written by the SavePage command (source admin|ai|system) with a one-step restore in the page history, the list of changes since the last publish on the Publish page, content export contract v1 (GET /cms-api/v1/export, optional page fields updatedAt, noindex, ogImage), content-addressed public media, Publish button with Jenkins trigger, poll fallback and callback, the form endpoint POST /forms/contact (honeypot, rate limit per client, reCAPTCHA v3 that rejects token-less posts, e-mail + database record, last-resort file; read-only submissions resource) and the path mode of the admin (CMS_ADMIN_PATH_MODE).
